$description: Checkbox V2 Component Contract. Value, interaction state and content structure remain independent; the Registry owns their legal axes.

value.meaning: selection value and aggregate selection result

pointerInteraction.meaning: default, hover and pressed express interaction visuals

focus.meaning: focused expresses keyboard focus with border-only ring

availability.meaning: disabled preserves value and locks all interaction

content.meaning: control-only and control-with-label define interaction surface structure

compositionRules: Value and State are independent axes; checked, unchecked and indeterminate are not interaction states.
Value changes only the Indicator structure and value palette; Label, Size and interaction state remain independent.
Pressed is visual-only and must not mutate Value inside the Token layer.
Disabled preserves the current Value and Indicator structure, changes availability visuals and locks interaction.
Focused enables a keyboard-only border Focus Ring; mouse hover and mouse press do not activate it.
Control-only uses the whole control as the interaction-size scope; control-with-label uses the indicator region for interaction sizing.
The indicator and label share one interaction surface; the label does not create an independent focus target.
Indeterminate transition semantics are owned by the runtime or the parent selection model.

recipeOwns: shared visual and interaction size references
contractDoesNotOwn: parent Table or Select selection semantics
